  (h₁ : ∀ n, 0 < n → f (f n) < f (n + 1)) :
  ∀ n, 0 < n → f n = n := by
  -- Step 1: `q ≤ f q` for all `q > 0`, by strong induction on the value `r = f q`.
  have hC : ∀ r q, 0 < q → f q = r → q ≤ r := by
    intro r
    induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ r ih =>
      intro q hq hfq
      by_contra hlt
      have hlt' : r < q := not_le.mp hlt
      have hpos := h₀ q
      rw [hfq] at hpos
      have hq' : q - 1 + 1 = q := by omega
      have h := h₁ (q - 1) (by omega)
      rw [hq', hfq] at h
      -- h : f (f (q - 1)) < r
      rcases le_or_gt r (f (q - 1)) with hr | hr
      · have := ih (f (f (q - 1))) h (f (q - 1)) (h₀ (q - 1)) rfl
        omega
      · have := ih (f (q - 1)) hr (q - 1) (by omega) rfl
        omega
  have hfix : ∀ q, 0 < q → q ≤ f q := fun q hq => hC (f q) q hq rfl
  -- Step 2: f is strictly increasing on positive integers.
  have hmono : ∀ n, 0 < n → f n < f (n + 1) := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 := h₁ n hn
    have h2 := hfix (f n) (h₀ n)
    omega
  have hg : StrictMono (fun k => f (k + 1)) :=
    strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ (fun k => hmono (k + 1) (Nat.succ_pos k))
  -- Step 3: conclude.
  intro n hn
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (hfix n hn)
  by_contra hcon
  have hcon' : n < f n := not_le.mp hcon
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, f n = k + 1 := ⟨f n - 1, by have := h₀ n; omega⟩
  have key := h₁ n hn
  rw [hk] at key
  have hgm : f (n + 1) ≤ f (k + 1) := hg.monotone (show n ≤ k by omega)
  omega

      ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_spec hex, fun m hm => Nat.find_min hex hm⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hfn, hv⟩ := hvP
    have hv1 := h₀ n
    have hvn : v < n := by omega
    have h1 := h₁ (n - 1) (by omega)
    have hsucc : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
    rw [hsucc, hv] at h1
    have hw0 := h₀ (n - 1)
    have hfw : f (n - 1) ≤ f (f (n - 1)) := by
      by_contra hcon2
      push_neg at hcon2
      exact hvmin (f (f (n - 1))) h1 ⟨f (n - 1), hw0, hcon2, rfl⟩
    exact hvmin (f (n - 1)) (by omega) ⟨n - 1, by omega, by omega, rfl⟩

    intro n hn
    have h := h₁ n hn

    have h := h₁ n hn
